definitions.gloss: starting with; including; X and others
definitions.explanation: Names the leading or best-known member of a group, then goes on to the rest: 'X and, along with it, others'. The fuller をはじめとして, and before a noun をはじめとする, are common in speeches and formal writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧をはじめ、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone, starting with the president, attended.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧をはじめ、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Japan has many old towns, Kyoto above all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧や⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧をはじめ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{日本料理|にほんりょうり}→日本料理：19425_nihonryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese food, such as sushi and tempura, is popular abroad too.

notes:
⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + はじめ (beginning); also written ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}め. The item named is the leading or most typical example, not the first in time.

FORMS:
- Nをはじめ、…: starting with N, …
- Nをはじめ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、…: the same, more formal
- Nをはじめ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ + noun: … such as N (before a noun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧: and so on — lists examples loosely, without singling one out
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{皮切|かわき}り→皮切り：13643_kawakiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: starting with — the first in a series of events in time
